featured.name: Switch List — Yard Switching Sim
featured.blurb: A free, open training simulator for railway conductors: read the yard, line the road, call PULL / SPOT / KICK, and win in the fewest engine moves. Every mechanic cites a Canadian Rail Operating Rule — built straight out of my own time working freight.
points: Line switches and call moves on a live yard canvas
Two scores — Moves (the goal) and Joints (couplings)
“Watch optimal” replays the fewest-moves line in slow motion
19 jobs, each machine-verified solvable at par before it ships

projects.name: CROR Trainer — Grande Prairie
projects.blurb: A browser study tool for CN freight conductors on the Grande Prairie yard, grounded in the January 2025 Canadian Rail Operating Rules: rule drills, an animated switching sim and puzzle, an interactive yard board, signal reading, and a step-by-step radio walkthrough.

projects.name: Echo Bat — Night Harvest
projects.blurb: A bat in the dark, harvesting glowing fruit by sonar. Your voice paints the cave, then the dark takes it back. A mobile-first, single-file canvas game.

projects.name: Sentinel-Pro
projects.blurb: A read-only trading-intelligence cockpit for S&P 500 futures: live market microstructure (depth, order-flow delta, volatility skew) fused with local-AI news classification — all self-hosted, no cloud. The demo runs the real dashboard on simulated data.

projects.name: Warcraft III — The Codex
projects.blurb: Custom survival and maze maps scripted in Lua — including a browser-playable homage to Coin Survival you can run right now.
